integrity: Published prior permutation-automaton central binomial upper bound and group orbit methods are explicitly credited; new content is DUFA closure, involutive sharp witnesses and exact alphabet necessity. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complete deterministic undirected finite automata. The formula is orbit-specific, with global binomial extremum over accepting subsets. The class of nondeterministic undirected automata is excluded. Correctness uses a mathematical proof and a bounded reproducible verifier; the literature novelty assessment has residual indexing risk. No independent audit or certification was performed.
title: Sharp reversal complexity and alphabet threshold for undirected deterministic automata
